title: Tour Consultant - FIT
description:
BESTINATION HOLIDAYS PVT. LTD.Job Description: Tour Consultant – FIT (Fully Independent Travel)

**Job Title:** Tour Consultant – FIT  
**Department:** FIT – International / Domestic Holidays  
**Location:** Palarivattom, Kochi  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2–4 years in the travel and tourism industry  
**Industry:** Travel, Tourism & Hospitality

About Bestination Holidays

Bestination Holidays Pvt. Ltd. is a travel management company committed to creating memorable travel experiences through personalised holiday planning and exceptional customer service. With 27+ years of service excellence, we specialise in customised holidays, international and domestic tour packages, group tours, flight bookings, hotel reservations, and visa assistance.

Our philosophy, **“Let’s Go Today,”** reflects our passion for helping travellers turn their holiday dreams into reality.

Job Summary

We are looking for a knowledgeable, customer-focused, and sales-driven **Tour Consultant – FIT** to join our team at HBR Layout, Bengaluru.

The candidate will be responsible for designing customised domestic and international holiday packages for individual travellers, couples, families, and small groups. The ideal candidate should have strong destination knowledge, excellent communication skills, supplier coordination experience, and the ability to convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Holiday Planning & Itinerary Development**

* Design personalised domestic and international holiday itineraries based on clients' preferences, budgets, and travel requirements.
* Prepare detailed day-wise itineraries, including sightseeing, transfers, activities, accommodation, and other travel arrangements.
* Recommend suitable destinations, hotels, experiences, and activities.
* Customise travel packages for families, couples, honeymooners, luxury travellers, and special-interest travellers.

**2. Sales & Enquiry Management**

* Handle customer enquiries received through telephone calls, WhatsApp, email, website leads, and other channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate holiday packages.
* Prepare quotations, follow up on leads, negotiate where appropriate, and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Maintain timely and consistent follow-ups with prospective customers.
* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and conversion benchmarks.

**3. Supplier Coordination & Reservations**

* Coordinate with domestic and international destination management companies (DMCs), hotels, transport providers, and activity operators.
* Obtain competitive rates and negotiate favourable commercial terms with suppliers.
* Manage hotel reservations, transfers, sightseeing, excursions, and other travel services.
* Verify availability, inclusions, exclusions, cancellation policies, and booking conditions before confirming reservations.

**4. Customer Service & Travel Support**

* Provide accurate information and professional assistance throughout the booking process.
* Communicate booking confirmations, vouchers, itineraries, and other travel documents to clients.
* Handle customer queries, special requests, itinerary changes, and complaints efficiently.
* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure smooth travel arrangements.
* Provide appropriate pre-travel support and assistance during travel when required.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer records, quotations, bookings, and supplier details in the company's CRM.
* Update enquiry status, follow-up schedules, sales pipelines, and booking details regularly.
* Prepare quotations and invoices in coordination with the relevant departments.
* Ensure all travel arrangements comply with company procedures and booking policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 2–4 years of experience in FIT holiday planning, customised travel packages, or travel sales.
* Good knowledge of domestic and international destinations, hotels, sightseeing, and travel logistics.
* Experience in preparing customised itineraries and costing holiday packages.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer-handling skills.
* Good numerical skills and the ability to calculate package costs, margins, and selling prices accurately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, email, and CRM systems.
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries and meet deadlines.
* Strong sales orientation and a customer-first mindset.

Preferred Experience

* Experience handling international FIT packages and customised holidays.
* Familiarity with destinations such as Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and other popular international holiday markets.
* Existing relationships with DMCs, hotels, and destination suppliers.
* Experience in upselling premium hotels, excursions, transfers, and value-added travel experiences.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of enquiries handled and qualified.
* Enquiry-to-booking conversion ratio.
* Monthly sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Speed and quality of quotation preparation.
* Lead follow-up effectiveness.
* Accuracy of costing, quotations, and reservations.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat bookings.
* CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
* Achievement of individual sales targets.

Personal Attributes

* Passion for travel and destination discovery.
* Professional attitude and a strong sense of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Confidence in communicating with customers and suppliers.
* Positive approach to sales, targets, and challenges.
* Attention to detail and commitment to service excellence.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing travel brand.
* A professional and supportive working environment.
* Opportunities to develop destination knowledge and travel industry expertise.
* Performance-based incentives, subject to company policy.
* Career growth opportunities within Bestination Holidays.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with details of their relevant FIT travel experience.

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines

* Prior experience in Deals/pre-sales/bid management and project management
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Good business acumen and understanding of business development, Deal/ project management and coordination skills
* Expert in computer skills like Microsoft suite and Internet-based research
* Experience with SharePoint is desirable
* Able to build collaborative relationships with a variety of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Education:**

* University/bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s in business administration

* Minimum 3 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English is essential as the role requires direct communication with international team members

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
